```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```
```{r}

library(nascaR.data)

# Load NASCAR Cup Series results
nascar <- load_series("cup")

# View the dataset
View(nascar)

```
```{r}

# Select 2025 race results
nascar_2025 <- subset(nascar, Season == 2025)

# Keep variables relevant to your story
nascar_story <- nascar_2025[, c(
  "Season", "Race", "Track",
  "Driver", "Start", "Finish"
)]

# View results
View(nascar_story)

```
```{r}

write.csv(
  nascar_story,
  "nascar_2025_results.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

```
